title: A Flocking Good Time
author: Nicholas Rockstroh
problems: Row 5 "robins allemande right 1½ and scoop up shadows" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 3 and 5 are too far apart to turn by the hand.
Row 6 "robins star promenade right ½" can't start from where the dancers are: Partners must be in the same minor set.
Row 7 "butterfly whirl" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0's partner is outside the group.
Row 8 "revolving door - larks take left hands and drop off shadows on other side" can't start from where the dancers are: revolving door whom must be one of partner, neighbor; got shadow.
Row 12 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0's partner is outside the group.
Row 2 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 4 "slide left along set" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 3 (couple 2) must stand on a side line.
The progression after row 4 "slide left along set" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must stand side by side to find new neighbors.
